query:
SELECT 
  r.id,
  r.nom,
  r.gamme,
  r.profil_olfactif
FROM recettes r
LEFT JOIN molecules_recettes mr ON r.id = mr.recette_id
WHERE mr.recette_id IS NULL
ORDER BY r.gamme, r.nom
LIMIT 30;
